# Session Summary

## What we built

A unified Rust library (`opendict-rs`) that reads both StarDict and MDict dictionary formats through a single `Dictionary` trait.

## Architecture

```
src/
  lib.rs            — Dictionary trait, DictKind enum, open()
  types.rs          — DictEntry, DictInfo (single shared types)
  stardict/
    mod.rs          — StarDictDictionary, trait impl, open_from_ifo helper
    ifo.rs          — .ifo metadata parser
    idx.rs          — .idx binary index (binary search, prefix search)
    dict.rs         — .dict/.dict.dz record reader (mmap, optional disk cache)
    syn.rs          — .syn synonym file parser
    strcmp.rs       — StarDict-compatible string comparison
    io.rs           — Shared file I/O (gzip detection)
  mdict/
    mod.rs          — MdictDictionary, trait impl, MDD discovery
    file.rs         — MdictFile: shared MDX/MDD parser (mmap + block cache)
    header.rs       — UTF-16LE XML header parser
    keys.rs         — Keyword section: index + blocks, decryption
    records.rs      — Record section index parser
    decompress.rs   — Block decompression (none/zlib/LZO) + decryption + adler32
    encoding.rs     — Multi-encoding decoding (UTF-8, UTF-16, GBK, Big5, etc.)
    keygen.rs       — v3 key derivation (xxhash64)
    ripemd128.rs    — RIPEMD-128 hash (v2 key derivation)
    decrypt.rs      — Nibble-swap XOR decryption
```

## Dictionary trait

```rust
pub trait Dictionary {
    fn lookup(&self, word: &str) -> Option<Vec<DictEntry>>;
    fn lookup_synonym(&self, word: &str) -> Option<Vec<DictEntry>>;
    fn word_list(&self) -> Vec<String>;
    fn word_count(&self) -> usize;
    fn info(&self) -> DictInfo;
    fn search_prefix(&self, prefix: &str, limit: usize) -> Vec<String>;
}
```

## MDict feature support

### Implemented

- **Versions**: v2.0 and v3.0 (both encrypted and unencrypted)
- **Encryption**: Keyword index decryption (RIPEMD-128 for v2, xxhash64 for v3), per-block nibble-swap XOR
- **Compression**: None, zlib, and LZO
- **Encodings**: UTF-8, UTF-16LE, GBK/GB2312/GB18030, Big5, and anything `encoding_rs` supports
- **Checksums**: Adler32 verification (v2: decompressed data, v3: decrypted data)
- **MDD resource files**: Companion .mdd files auto-loaded alongside .mdx for CSS/images/fonts
- **Prefix search**: Binary search on sorted index with `partition_point`
- **Block cache**: Single-entry LRU cache with `Arc<Vec<u8>>` avoids redundant decompression
- **Memory-mapped I/O**: Both StarDict and MDict use mmap for file data

### Not implemented

- v1.2 format (different field sizes)
- Salsa20 encryption (keyword header bit 1, per-block method 2)
- StyleSheet/Compact mode
- Fuzzy search

## Performance

Benchmarked in release mode against real dictionaries.

### MDict mmap improvement

Oxford English Dictionary (277k words, ~230MB .mdx):

| Metric | Vec (before) | Mmap (after) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| RSS delta | 233.7 MB | 23.8 MB | **-90%** |
| Load time | 101 ms | 64 ms | -37% |
| Lookup | 8,539 ns/word | 8,649 ns/word | ~same |

### Load time

| Dictionary | Format | Words | Load |
|---|---|---|---|
| Langdao CN-EN | StarDict | 405k | 10 ms |
| Modern Chinese | StarDict | 58k | 1 ms |
| Korean-English | StarDict | 50k | 2 ms |
| Spanish-English | StarDict | 99k | 21 ms |
| CN-EN 新世纪 | MDict | 137k | 34 ms |
| Oxford OED | MDict | 277k | 64 ms |
| JP Names | MDict | 67k | 22 ms |
| Italian | MDict | 5k | 2 ms |

### Lookup (sequential, all words)

| Dictionary | Format | ns/word |
|---|---|---|
| Langdao CN-EN | StarDict | 381 |
| Modern Chinese | StarDict | 437 |
| Korean-English | StarDict | 955 |
| Spanish-English | StarDict | 436 |
| CN-EN 新世纪 | MDict | 1,479 |
| Oxford OED | MDict | 8,649 |
| JP Names | MDict | 919 |
| Italian | MDict | 2,238 |

### Prefix search

1-4 us/search across all dictionaries — comparable between formats.

## Test coverage

165 tests total (all passing):

- 38 unit tests (inline `#[cfg(test)]` modules)
  - `encoding.rs` — 11 tests (decode_str, null_width)
  - `keygen.rs` — 7 tests (derive_key, xxhash64 verification)
  - `header.rs` — 13 tests (decode_utf16le, parse_xml_attrs)
  - `ripemd128.rs` — 3 tests (known hash vectors)
  - `decrypt.rs` — 1 test (fast_decrypt reference output)
  - `decompress.rs` — 5 tests (LZO round-trip, bad data, checksum, block size, encryption)
- 20 mdict fixture tests (header, keywords, lookups, full Dictionary pipeline)
- 78 StarDict tests (ifo, idx, dict, syn, strcmp, integration)
- 22 real dictionary tests (`#[ignore]`, require files in tests/dicts/)

### MDict fixture

`tests/fixtures/test.mdx` — 408-byte synthetic .mdx file (v2.0, UTF-8, zlib, no encryption, 3 entries). Generated by `examples/gen_mdx_fixture.rs`. Exercises the full parsing pipeline: header → keys → records → decompression → lookup.

## Cleanup done

- Renamed project from stardict → opendict-rs across all crates, packages, and bindings
- Unified two duplicate `DictEntry` structs into one in `types.rs`
- Extracted shared `open_from_ifo` helper (removed ~30 lines of duplication)
- Deleted dead `records::read_record` function
- Deleted dead `Translation`/`TranslationItem` legacy types
- Fixed `unwrap()` panics on malformed input in `dict.rs` and `mod.rs`
- Fixed stale `stardict_mobile` references in `.gitignore`
- Made dict.gz disk caching opt-in via `Dict::open(path, cache_to_disk)`
- Switched MDict from `std::fs::read` to mmap (90% RSS reduction on large files)
